subject: Staged handoff & MAP: BrightCart evaluation dataset, prompt pack, and usage gates
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@brightcart.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T10:14:00-08:00
Subject: Staged handoff & MAP: BrightCart evaluation dataset, prompt pack, and usage gates

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per our conversation I put together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the handoff items we discussed for the BrightCart pilot. The goal is to get you a small, representative evaluation corpus + a lightweight prompt pack and a guarded sandbox so your ML team can run the acceptance tests in under 2 weeks.

Key constraints (please confirm):
- Ephemeral access: dataset + prompts available for 30 days from provisioning.
- No redistribution: the materials are for BrightCart evaluation only; no reselling or external sharing.
- Scoped users: access limited to the BrightCart Data Science & QA groups identified in the MPA.
- Redaction: PII has been redacted from the sample dataset; any additional masking requests will require a short turnaround.

Attachments I am sending with this thread: BR-Cart_eval_manifest_v1.csv (manifest of files & schema), promptpack-lite-v2.zip (50 sample prompts + expected acceptance checks), MAP_timeline_v1.xlsx (proposed milestones & owners).

Proposed condensed timeline:
1) Day 0: DocuSign MPA executed (we will provide link).
2) Day 1: Provision staging bucket + ephemeral service account to BrightCart (read-only).
3) Day 2–10: BrightCart runs acceptance tests, reports failures via tracker (we will provide a Jira template).
4) Day 11–14: Wrap, feedback call, mutually agreed closure and takedown.

Next steps for us: I can send the DocuSign package now; Lauren will create the staging bucket and Priyom will stand up the ephemeral provision. Can you confirm procurement/PO cadence so we can attach the PO to the MAP?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to execution.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lin <sarah@brightcart.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: David Procure <david.procure@brightcart.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Staged handoff & MAP: BrightCart evaluation dataset, prompt pack, and usage gates

Thanks Rishi — this looks sensible and lean. A few quick items from procurement & security:
- Procurement: we'll need a PO template to attach to the MAP, and our procurement team prefers the PO be uploaded before Day 1 provisioning. I've attached our PO template for your legal team to review.
- Security: can you confirm where the staging bucket will be hosted and what logging/audit artifacts Redwood will provide? SOC2 evidence or an Attestation would be helpful for our compliance folks.
- Data minimization: the sample manifest looks fine, but can you confirm there are no free-text customer notes in the set (we need to avoid any residual customer identifiers)?

Assuming those are covered, BrightCart agrees to the 30-day ephemeral window. I'll loop in David (procurement) to drive the PO.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Sarah
Sarah Lin
Director, Data Science — BrightCart Inc.

Attachment: BR_Procurement_PO_template.pdf
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah@brightcart.com>, David Procure <david.procure@brightcart.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Staged handoff & MAP: BrightCart evaluation dataset, prompt pack, and usage gates

Looping in operational steps and owners so we have a single checklist:

Operational checklist (Lauren / Priyom / Rishi owners):
- Legal: upload MPA to DocuSign and set signer order (Customer -> Redwood). Rishi to approve final. (Target: EOD today)
- Staging: create S3-staging bucket in us-west-2, enable object-level logging, lifecycle rule -> auto-delete after 35 days (to allow takedown buffer). Priyom to provision and post service account keys to the secure share. (Target: Day 0–1)
- Access: create ephemeral service account with read-only access; set IAM allow-list to the IPs provided by BrightCart. Priyom.
- Audit/artifacts: enable DataPlane access logs and provide a trimmed SOC2 attestation excerpt and storage audit extract for BrightCart security. Rishi to attach SOC2 extract.
- Acceptance: provide a simple Jira template and acceptance checklist (pass/fail per prompt) and a shared folder for results. Lauren to create.

Timeline (compressed):
- Today (Day 0): DocuSign link out; Rishi to send.
- Day 1: Staging bucket + service account provisioned; BrightCart uploads acceptance runner results.
- Day 3–10: Acceptance window + triage cadence (3x weekly sync or as-needed).
- Day 11–14: Close call + takedown.

Privacy note: confirm with Sarah that the manifest contains no editable free-text customer notes. If there is anything flagged we will scrub and re-upload within 48 hours.

I'll set the DocuSign and the Drive folder; Rishi, if you can send the final attachments and the DS link I will kick off provisioning.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Onboarding — Redwood Inference

Forwarding the finalized MPA bundle and the artifacts Lauren mentioned. Quick notes inline:

- Staging bucket: us-west-2, bucket name redwood-eval-brightcart-3204-staging. Logs will be shared as storage-audit-YYYYMMDD.csv.
- SOC2: attached is the attestation excerpt that covers storage and access controls. Not the full report, but the security team can request a more detailed extract if needed.

DocuSign link: https://redwood.app/docusign/BR-3204-MAP
Drive folder (provisioned): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-eval-staging

Please sign the MPA when convenient and David, if you can upload the PO to the Drive folder we will treat that as the provisioning trigger.

Thanks everyone — will stand by for signature and PO.

— Rishi
